hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: If k == 26, any character modification still allows all 26 distinct characters, so the answer is always 1.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Represent the distinct characters in the current partition using a 26-bit mask.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Use memoized dynamic programming with state (i, mask, changed) exploring either keeping s[i] or modifying it once to any lowercase letter.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Memoized dynamic programming across linear string index and boolean changed flag.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute forcing every character modification and recalculating partitions takes O(26 * n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that greedy partition state only depends on distinct character bitmask.
